source.notes: Scanned school paper with no text layer (only the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected against the page images. No school name is printed. Printed header: Grade: VIII, Time: 2 hours, Assessment – II, Subject : Physics, Maximum Marks : 80. No year is printed on the paper; examYear 2024 is taken from the file name (...-290224-2024) and the icseboard.org folder. Section A is compulsory; groups I-IV print only a group total ([8] each), so each group is kept as one entry with that total (never split); V is a single 8-mark question. Section B has six questions of 10 marks each (a/b/c printed [3]/[3]/[4]) of which any four are to be attempted, so the listed marks add up to 100, not 80. Section A numbers are stored as printed Roman numerals (I-V) and Section B as 1-6 (printed Q1-Q6). Powers of ten were rebuilt as Unicode superscripts from the page image (flagged). The paper's own wording and spellings (e.g. 'phenomena', 'arangement', 'lighting conductor', 'in called', '(i) ... (iii)' in Q5 b) are kept. The Whatsapp advertisement on page 2 and the icseboard.org watermark are ignored. No answer key is printed.

questions.text:
Fill in the blanks:-
1) An incident ray which passes through the focus of the mirror, passes ____ to the principal axis after reflection.
2) The image which cannot be obtained on a screen is called a ____ .
3) Boiling is a ____ phenomena.
4) Increasing in length of an iron rod on heating is termed as ____.
5) The word amplitude is used to describe the ____ of the wave.
6) Violin is an example of ____ instrument.
7) ____ electricity is the electricity produced by friction.
8) An electric ____ is a safety device installed to safeguard electrical appliances .

True / False :-
1) The outer surface of the spoon is known as the concave surface.
2) Refraction can take place in the same media if the densities of different layers vary.

5) The more the area of the vibrating body, the louder is the sound.
6) The loudness of a wave is highly dependent on energy.
7) Glass is a good conductor of electricity.
8) All the electrical appliances are connected in line in our household.

questions.text:
Multiple choice questions:-
1) What is the speed of light in vacuum ?
a) 3 × 10¹⁰ ms⁻¹ b) 3 × 10⁸ ms⁻¹ c) 2 × 10¹⁰ ms⁻¹ d) 1.5 × 10⁸ ms⁻¹
2) The point at which the principal axis touches the surface of the mirror
a) principal axis b) pole c) focal length d) focal point
3) Changing of a liquid into vapours at a fixed temperature is called
a) expansion b) boiling c) evaporation d) fusion
4) Evaporation from surface of any liquid depends on.
b) temperature b) wind c) nature of liquid d) all of these
5) The loudness of sound is measured in
a) newton b) decibel c) metre d) watt
6) It is an example of air column or wind instrument
a) guitar b) flute c) sitar d) tabla
7) The flow of electrons in wires and appliances is known as.
a) electric current b) electric potential c) electric field d) all of these
8) This device or arangement is used to save high buildings from lighting.
a) electroscope b) lighting conductor c) telescope d) none of these

questions.text:
Answer in one word :-
1) Rapid vaporisation of liquid at a particular temperature.
2) The maximum vertical displacement of a wave from its mean position.
3) A continuous sound, especially someone's voice, that doesn't rise and fall in pitch.
4) SI unit of frequency.
5) The flow of electric charges in a circuit.
6) The study of charges at rest is called
7) A group of cell joined in series in called
8) Colour of live wire.
